summary: FD_TC_074_No Travel Incomplete, Outside carrier control (fallback: departure delay code 97, industrial action outside own airline), APPR
title: No Travel Incomplete, Outside carrier control (fallback: departure delay code 97, industrial action outside own airline), APPR
description:
Two-leg journey. Leg 1 operated on time. Leg 2 was delayed more than 3 hours. There's no cancellation code and no arrival delay code, so the rules engine falls back to the first departure delay code, 97. In this scenario, airside operations staff employed by the YYZ airport authority went on strike (uncontrollable). The customer was stranded at the connection (YYZ), chose not to continue, and didn't return to YUL. Checks that the fallback path is used, that No Travel Incomplete plus an uncontrollable fallback code returns Not Eligible under APPR, and that the customer is entitled to a pro-rated or full refund of the unused portion.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC063: one adult passenger, two AC domestic legs YUL?YYZ?YVR, May 29, 2026. Leg 1 AC 466 YUL?YYZ: operated, on time, no delay codes. Leg 2 AC 467 YYZ?YVR: scheduled 11:00 ? 13:05 (local). Actual departure 14:40 (220 min late). Actual arrival 16:50 (225 min late). Status: DELAYED (operated). Cancellation code: NONE. Arrival delay code: NOT AVAILABLE (null/empty). First departure delay code 97 (MI). Customer action: stranded at YYZ (midpoint). Didn't board Leg 2, so the Leg 2 coupon wasn't flown. Didn't return to YUL. Didn't reach YVR. No Travel status: Incomplete. No rebooking accepted.
